reviews.comment: This lab course was new for this professor but he did an amazing job! The lab work was easy to read and follow, and his instructions were clear as he followed it with the group step by step. There are clear lab report guidelines provided so no worries there too. Quizzes are basic knowledge gained from labs, so if you pay attention you'll be fine :)
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things
